subject: Post-call: Upheld Health sponsor recap, risks & procurement ramp
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Liu <dana.liu@upheldhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Upheld Health sponsor recap, risks & procurement ramp

Dana — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and clear next steps so we keep momentum toward a pilot with Upheld Health. I’ve kept this focused for your exec sponsor and procurement loop.

Call summary / primary pain points you confirmed:
- Latency variability on current vendor endpoints (95th percentile spikes >400ms for critical triage flows) impacting clinician throughput and patient wait times.
- Unit cost unpredictability when model usage spikes near month-end; finance needs deterministic per-request economics.
- Data residency & audit: must demonstrate encryption-in-flight and at-rest, plus SOC 2 Type II evidence and export control posture.
- Ops constraints: onboarding devs to the new runtime requires a private VPC option and peering to your GCP project to meet firewall policies.

Business outcomes you want: (what success looks like)
- Reduce 95th percentile generation latency to <150ms for short clinical prompts while supporting bursts up to 2k reqs/min.
- Predictable monthly unit cost with clear pilot pricing and post-pilot committed throughput discounts.
- Security sign-off (security questionnaire + SOC 2 artifacts) completed during pilot so procurement can approve a Q3 production contract.

Immediate procurement / onboarding path (proposed):
1) Technical deep-dive + architecture walkthrough (Redwood infra + peering) — target Jun 23 (owner: Sean).
2) Security questionnaire + evidence exchange — you to share questionnaire; Redwood to return artifacts and a short controls memo by Jun 25 (owner: Dana / Sean).
3) 12-week dedicated pilot on a reserved pool (pilot SOW attached), commercial terms: pilot monthly fee + usage with cap; aim to convert to reserved capacity with 12-month commit on success (owner: Marissa).
4) Legal & procurement review (SOW -> PO) with procurement checklist and sample redlines (owner: Karthik).

Open risk / escalation items we flagged on the call:
- Export controls / model weights policy: if your security team requires on-prem variants or strict model whitelisting we may need to scope the private deployment early.
- Networking: peering timelines with GCP could delay pilot start if your infra team requires a security review (suggest parallelizing evidence exchange).
- Pricing gate: finance needs an upper-bound cost estimate for peak month; Marissa will provide a capped scenario.

Next steps (owners & dates):
- Dana: share Upheld security questionnaire by end of day Fri, Jun 19.
- Sean: schedule technical deep-dive for Jun 23 and share dial-in + agenda by EOD Mon.
- Marissa: draft pilot commercial estimate & SOW update by Jun 25 (attached v1).
- Karthik: prepare procurement checklist & sample contract timeline for legal by Jul 2.

Attachments: SOW-draft-upheld-v1.pdf (pilot scope), upheld-security-questionnaire.xlsx (placeholder — will be completed by Dana), pilot-success-metrics.xlsx (what we’ll measure).

If that matches your read, please reply to confirm owners and add any missing items. Appreciated — look forward to the deep-dive.

—
Sean Gallagher
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Dana Liu <dana.liu@upheldhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Park <evelyn.park@upheldhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Upheld Health sponsor recap, risks & procurement ramp

Sean — thanks for the concise recap, this is helpful. Confirming a few items from our side and attaching the questionnaire now.

Key confirmations:
- Evelyn (CTO) is the exec sponsor and will be involved in the security review.
- We can commit to the Jun 23 technical deep-dive — our infra lead (cc'ed on a separate invite) will join.
- Procurement will want a capped pilot spend scenario for approval; please ensure the SOW has a clear not-to-exceed.

I’ve attached the security questionnaire (see attachment stub). I’ll also pull together our SOC 2 monitoring expectations and share by Monday.

Short note: our legal team will likely request a custom DPA clause around PHI handling — we’ll surface redlines after the evidence exchange.

Thanks — Dana

Attachments: upheld-security-questionnaire.xlsx (uploaded)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Upheld Health pilot pricing / SOW updates (prep for deep-dive)

Marissa / Karthik — moving this to internal so we can line up owners and not block the Jun 23 deep-dive. Summary of actions we need to close this week: 

Commercial / pricing (owner: Marissa)
- Update SOW-draft-upheld-v1 with a 12-week pilot model, include a not-to-exceed cap for month 1 and for peak usage. Finance wants an example peak-cost calc for 1M tokens/day and for a 3x burst scenario.
- Proposal for pilot discount and conversion pricing: suggest pilot discount 20% off list for the pilot months, with optional 6–12 month reserved pricing ladder post-conversion — want your recommendation by Jun 25.

Procurement & legal (owner: Karthik)
- Prepare procurement checklist and sample contract timeline; flag DPA/PHI redlines as early blockers.
- Draft a short escalation note (internal) describing when to escalate to sales leadership — e.g., if legal requests on-prem-only or if SOC 2 artifacts cannot be provided within 10 business days.

Technical / Ops support (owner: Sean)
- Runbook for the Jun 23 deep-dive: agenda = architecture, peering steps (GCP), KV cache behavior for short prompts, failover model variants, success metrics mapping.
- Bring a sample perf profile and expected 95th latency under the proposed reserved pool size.

Risk mitigation notes (for the SOW):
- Add a clause for a mutually agreed rollback path if data residency work requires private deployment timelines that exceed 6 weeks after pilot start.
- Include a controlled model-variant whitelist to address export control concerns during pilot.

Links: HubSpot deal UPH-9842 and SOW draft in Drive (links attached in thread metadata).

I’ll schedule the deep-dive calendar invite; please confirm availability ASAP. If you think pilot discount should differ, raise it in thread — Marissa, take lead.

—Sean

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Upheld Health pilot pricing / SOW updates (prep for deep-dive)

Acknowledged — I’ll own the commercial package for the pilot. Quick plan: 
- I’ll update the SOW with a clear not-to-exceed and three pricing scenarios (low / expected / peak) by Jun 25.
- Recommend pilot discount of 15% (not 20%) to keep conversion economics reasonable; I’ll show both options in the estimate.
- I’ll coordinate with finance to provide the two example peak-cost calc sheets for 1M tokens/day and 3x burst.

Karthik — I’ll ping you directly to align on the DPA redlines I expect based on Dana’s note (PHI focus). If legal pushes a heavy on-prem ask, we should surface to sales leadership immediately.

Will update the Drive SOW and post a comment with highlights.

—Marissa
